title: Rabbi Tafdai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 8:11, speaking in Rabbi Acha’s name; Hyman reports Seder HaDorot’s reading R' Tafrai. Bereshit Rabbah 14:3 has Rabbi Tafdui.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital texts of Bereshit Rabbah 8:11 and 14:3 support Tafdai and Tafdui respectively. The latter locator belongs to Bereshit Rabbah, not to the intervening report of Seder HaDorot’s Tafrai reading.

The whole Torat Emet Bereshit Rabbah 8:11 paragraph first has Rabbi Tafdai in Rabbi Acha’s name and later separately writes Rav Acha. The whole 14:3 paragraph has Rabbi Tafdui in Rabbi Acha’s name. Those local titles and differing forms remain. Hyman’s Seder HaDorot Tafrai reading was not freshly collated and uses R' rather than a transferred full title; the existing locator note remains verbatim.
